feature: File Inspector plugin with plugin ID `file-inspector`, action ID `inspect-file`, engine `explorer-action`, and variant `default`
Read-only single-file Explorer action for any readable regular file, with an 8 TiB input limit and no storage or network permission
One-pass CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 calculation with progress and cancellation
Strict expected digest normalization and verification with algorithm inference, explicit prefixes, and constant-time comparison of equal-length bytes
A 64-byte hexadecimal and ASCII header snapshot, BOM detection, and recognition of ZIP, GZIP, PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF87a, GIF89a, ELF, DEX, and SQLite 3 signatures
Pure JVM implementation with no native library, unrestricted ABIs declared by `supportedAbis = emptyArray()`, one ABI-independent APK, and required AutoJs6 host build 5268

Localized metadata, interface text, usage instructions, README files, and changelogs in Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
